helpful: The salience-band segment table with bracketed reached rates — it is exactly the anchor a banded forward cell needs, and the per-Term rows made pooling strictly-prior Terms mechanical.
Provisioned petition and QP text with a documents.json manifest — no fetching needed, and the truncation/empty_text fields answer the questions that would otherwise burn retrieval calls.
gaps: No base-rate cut conditions on a waived response / call-for-response state; CFR probability is the dominant term in a grant path from a waived-BIO docket and I had to set it by judgment.

distribution_count counts motion distributions alongside petition distributions (here the sealing motion 25M86 made a never-conferenced petition look twice-distributed); a petition-only distribution count would sharpen both the band and relist-increment resolution.

notes: Forward cell with a same-day snapshot; provisioned inputs were sufficient and retrieval was needed only for verification, most of which the statpack could not and CourtListener did not provide.
